# AI's role

**What job does AI do in making the content?** · [all approaches](index.md) · clashes: C8, C22


## AI as editor
<a id="ai-editor"></a>

Give Claude a reference reel and the raw footage; it edits in that style; you give feedback in words; then turn it into a skill.

**Looks like:** Raw footage goes in and an edit with cuts, captions, cards and sound comes back. You say 'tighter at the start, less zoom' and get v2.

**Good at:** speed once set up; repeatable style; no timeline work

**Weak at:** needs taste to judge; can look generic without a good reference

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches all · goals speed · effort medium

**How:** ffmpeg, faster-whisper, OpenCV and HyperFrames via Claude Code. Save the workflow as a skill.

**Backed by:** [Reference-driven AI editing](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-reference-driven-edit), [Turn the workflow into a skill](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-turn-into-skill), [Seven-repo editing stack](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-seven-tool-stack), [Storyboard table before any edit](../topics/process.md#l10-storyboard-before-edit), [AI prompt: unique, specific, observed](../topics/ai-tools.md#ideas-unique-specific-observed) · sources L04, L10

## AI writes the plan, you approve
<a id="ai-planner"></a>

AI drafts the storyboard or blueprint; a human fixes it; then AI or a human builds it.

**Looks like:** Claude proposes a 20-beat table, you change six rows and approve it, and the build follows the table.

**Good at:** keeps human taste in charge; fewer surprises; plans sound and visuals together

**Weak at:** extra step; plans can be over-detailed

**Best for:** formats reel60, reel90, yt-long · niches all · goals retention, trust · effort medium

**How:** Storyboard prompt from L10, then 'build it'.

**Backed by:** [Storyboard table before any edit](../topics/process.md#l10-storyboard-before-edit), [Edit blueprint per video](../topics/process.md#proc-edit-blueprint), [AI for ideation, not scripting](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-ideation-not-scripting), [AI prompt: unique, specific, observed](../topics/ai-tools.md#ideas-unique-specific-observed), [Turn the workflow into a skill](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-turn-into-skill) · sources L10, SP

## AI for ideas and research only
<a id="ai-ideation-research"></a>

AI finds unique, specific, observed situations and does research; the human writes and performs.

**Looks like:** Ask: 'What's the most specific situation a beginner PC builder has lived?' Get 20 situations, pick one, and write it in your own words.

**Good at:** original voice; taste stays human; fast idea lists

**Weak at:** no time saved on editing; AI ideas can be generic

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short, yt-long, carousel · niches all · goals trust, reach · effort low

**How:** Chat prompts for ideation; WebSearch for facts.

**Backed by:** [AI for ideation, not scripting](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-ideation-not-scripting), [AI prompt: unique, specific, observed](../topics/ai-tools.md#ideas-unique-specific-observed), [AI is only as good as your taste](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-only-as-good-as-taste), [Turn the workflow into a skill](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-turn-into-skill) · sources L08, L09

## AI for craft jobs (sound, motion, measuring)
<a id="ai-craft-helper"></a>

AI handles specific craft: placing SFX, easing curves, word timings, measuring reference reels.

**Looks like:** You cut the reel. AI adds a pop on every text frame, eases the zooms, and checks loudness at −14 LUFS. The creative calls stay yours.

**Good at:** polish at low cost; precise timing; measurable checks

**Weak at:** tools need setup; AI can't hear, so it needs a listening check

**Best for:** formats reel30, reel60, reel90, yt-short · niches all · goals retention, speed · effort medium

**How:** real-sfx and earshot skills, the four-line easing prompt, faster-whisper.

**Backed by:** [AI sound stack: Real SFX + earshot](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-real-sfx-placement), [The four-line easing prompt](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-easing-prompt), [Word-level transcription for captions and cuts](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-word-level-transcription), [Measure reference reels with code](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-measure-reels-pipeline), [AI is only as good as your taste](../topics/ai-tools.md#ai-only-as-good-as-taste) · sources L02, L03, R1

## Mixing
They stack: AI for ideas, a human script, an AI storyboard, then an AI edit with craft tools. Harry and Briar draw the line at writing; L04 and L10 hand over editing.

## Rule of thumb
Speed on repeat formats: AI editor. Effect-heavy pieces: AI planner. Voice and originality: ideation only. Polish on a human edit: craft helper.
